title: There's a Road Rage Button in GTA 6 (and Your Car Door Is a Weapon) 🚗 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has a dedicated road rage shortcut: press R3 in a vehicle and your character yells at people nearby. PC Gamer's list of hidden GTA 6 controls also found: tap Square to swing the driver door open (clip bikers or bonk a cop), hold Circle to duck lower in your seat while cops search, and double tap Triangle to get out and keep the engine running.

Source: PC Gamer (15 hidden GTA 6 controls and features you should know about, Nov 20, 2026).
Images: Rockstar Games (Trailer 2 / An Extended Look). Door shot is illustrative.
